title: A password manager
why: Never build your own security software, and never let an AI build it for you. Scans of publicly launched AI-built apps found thousands of serious vulnerabilities and hundreds of leaked secrets. This is the category where a mistake costs you everything. Bitwarden is free, open source, and audited.
tool: Don't build it. Bitwarden's free tier
